entry.name: Riveted Gauntlets
entry.description: Iron-riveted leather and plate gauntlets built to break a shield wall.

entry.name: Focus Orb
entry.description: A glass sphere held in the off hand. Channels Catalyst Pulse and lets field skills reach one tile further.

entry.name: Hold Line
entry.description: {name}: -{mitigation} damage this round; grants Fortify (+{magnitude}) for {rounds}.

entry.name: Taunt Shout
entry.description: {name}: grants taunt for {rounds} starting next round. Foes that can reach you must target you.

entry.name: Dread Roar
entry.description: {name}: {stagger} stagger, {potency} to Weaken (-{magnitude} outgoing power) for {rounds} within {range}.

entry.name: Phalanx Cover
entry.description: {name}: -{mitigation} damage and Steadfast for {rounds}; intercepts one adjacent melee hit on an ally and fortifies self.

entry.name: Sweep Kick
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {stagger} stagger in a ring around you.

entry.name: Reckless Lunge
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {stagger} stagger. Dashes up to {dash} to close.

entry.name: Collar Clinch
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {stagger} stagger, sure break; {potency} to Slow for {rounds}.

entry.name: Ramming Charge
entry.description: {name}: dashes up to {dash} for {power} power, {stagger} stagger, and pushes the target back.

entry.name: Disengage Step
entry.description: {name}: jump up to {jump} away from the nearest enemy (or a chosen one) to break melee contact. Your move for the round: it comes first, leaps over units but not walls, and a rooted unit can't.

entry.name: Spotter's Mark
entry.description: {name}: {stagger} stagger, {potency} to Expose (-{magnitude} armor) for {rounds} at {range}, and reveals enemy intent.

entry.name: Snare Wire
entry.description: {name}: places a hidden tripwire at {range} that roots advancing foes.

entry.name: Steady Aim
entry.description: {name}: +{boost} power on your next attack within {rounds}.

entry.name: Flank Cut
entry.description: Maneuver, Snap: {name}: {power} power, {stagger} stagger. Dashes up to {range} {position}, then hits.

entry.name: Backflip
entry.description: {name}: leap up to {jump} away from melee contact over intervening units.

entry.name: Slip & Feint
entry.description: {name}: slips up to {range} {position} for {power} power, {potency} to Slow for {rounds}; ends DEFENSIVE.

entry.name: Exploit Opening
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {exploit}.

entry.name: Tend Wounds
entry.description: {name}: heals {heal} on an ally within {range}, or yourself.

entry.name: Cauterize
entry.description: {name}: heals {heal} and cleanses {cleanse} within {range}.

entry.name: Urgent Triage
entry.description: {name}: heals an ally ({heal}) within {range} and grants haste for {rounds}; guards broken allies.

entry.name: Ward Litany
entry.description: {name}: grants Fortify (+{magnitude}) for {rounds} and {extra} within {range}.

entry.name: Cinder Spark
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {stagger} stagger in a cross at {range}.

entry.name: Pitch Firebomb
entry.description: {name}: burst at {range} for {power} power, {potency} to Burn ({magnitude}) for {rounds}, and leaves pitch fire.

entry.name: Alum Frost-Pot
entry.description: {name}: burst at {range} for {power} power, {stagger} stagger, and {potency} to Root for {rounds}.

entry.name: Choke-Vapor Bomb
entry.description: {name}: burst at {range} for {power} power, {potency} to Poison ({magnitude}) for {rounds}, and leaves choke-gas.

entry.name: Shield Bash
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {stagger} stagger, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}, and pushes the target back.

entry.name: Counter-Guard
entry.description: {name}: -{mitigation} damage; grants riposte for {rounds} to counter adjacent melee attacks you survive.

entry.name: Iron Brace
entry.description: Stand, Snap: -{mitigation} damage this round and Fortify (+{magnitude}) for {rounds}.

entry.name: Press-Reload
entry.description: Off-hand, Snap: reload ammo to full and gain +{boost} attack power within {rounds}; ends OFFENSIVE.

entry.name: Fade-Step
entry.description: Off-hand: leap up to {jump} away from melee contact over intervening units.

entry.name: Catalyst Pulse
entry.description: Off-hand: +{boost} attack power within {rounds}; ends OFFENSIVE.

entry.name: Cite Passage
entry.description: Off-hand: heals an ally ({heal}) within {range}, cleanses {cleanse}, and grants {status} (+{magnitude}) for {rounds}.

entry.name: Hamstring
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Root for {rounds}.

entry.name: Volley
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Plus area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Sunder
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Armor-breaking chop.

entry.name: Aimed Shot
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. A patient shot.

entry.name: Pinning Shot
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Root for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Arcane Bolt
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. A bolt of raw force.

entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Bleed for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Dashes up to {dash}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Gap-close: the dash is your move for the round.

entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Holy force from a distance.

entry.name: Deadeye
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Judgement
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Dashes up to {dash}. Gap-close: the dash is your move for the round.

entry.name: Lacerate
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Bleed for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Assassinate
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.description: Greater Mend: heals 10 + 1.8 x KNOW; cleanses stun. Within 3 tiles, or yourself.

entry.name: Renewal
entry.description: {name}: heals {heal}; grants haste for {rounds} starting next round. Within 3 tiles.

entry.name: Leap Back
entry.description: {name}: jump up to {jump} away from the nearest enemy (or a chosen one) to break melee contact. Your move for the round: it comes first, leaps over units but not walls, and a rooted unit can't.

entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Line area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Aim at an adjacent tile; hits the 3 tiles in a line.

entry.name: Cyclone Kick
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds} on every enemy hit. Ring area around you. Bare hands or feet.

entry.name: Inferno
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Bleed for {rounds} on every enemy hit. Burst area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Shield Wall
entry.description: {name}: -{mitigation} damage; grants taunt for {rounds} and {extra}. Foes that can reach you must target you, starting next round.

entry.name: Crippling Shot
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Slow for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Rend Armor
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Expose (-{magnitude}) for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Envenom
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Poison ({magnitude} per round, stacks) for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.description: {name}: grants Regen ({magnitude} per round) for {rounds} starting next round.

entry.name: Feint
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {flow}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Crushing Blow
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {disrupt}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Braced Stand
entry.description: +15 max Poise; immune to forced movement while guarding.

entry.name: Iron Counter
entry.description: Gains 1 AP when blocking a hit while guarding (once per round).

entry.name: Iron Shoulders
entry.description: +2 CONS; forced moves you deal push 1 extra tile.

entry.name: Kiln Endurance
entry.description: Single-block hits deal no stagger; below 50% HP gains Empower (+10%) for 2 rounds (once per battle).

entry.name: Long Sight
entry.description: +2 PERC; +1 reach on ranged attacks.

entry.name: Patient Sight
entry.description: +15% status potency; ranged stance breaks return 1 AP (once per round).

entry.name: Twin-Blade Rhythm
entry.description: When dual-wielding light weapons: +8% crit, +50% off-hand jab power, and off-hand jabs grant 1 AP and inflict Bleed once per round.

entry.name: Gutter Reflex
entry.description: 40% resistance to Slow and Root; gains Haste for 1 round on evade (once per round).

entry.name: Triage Cadence
entry.description: +8 max Poise; healing an ally below 35% HP restores 1 AP (once per round).

entry.name: Surgical Hand
entry.description: +15% healing potency; +10% status potency.

entry.name: Reactive Reagents
entry.description: 50% resistance to Burn and Poison; hits on burning foes inflict Expose (-3 armor).

entry.name: Catalytic Reserve
entry.description: +1 INT; +10% power on Pitch Firebomb, Alum Frost-Pot, and Choke-Vapor Bomb.
